answer: Decaying bonds stop fakes. Each agent posts 200 tokens losing 5% per epoch, like a dune shedding sand, unless work renews it. The agent stakes, then does two audits; only real work tops it up, idle bonds on a ledge drain fastest. 100 fakes cost 100 x 10 tokens each epoch, 1,000 for nothing. Bonds cannot transfer, so a bought identity has no history, even in sable. One honest agent pays once, renews from earnings, keeps rewards undiluted.
